title: Configuring the Ransomware Kill Switch for a Site

blocks.text: The Ransomware Kill Switch allows you to change a site's threat level color code to one of four preset severities with a single click to immediately shut down vulnerable protocols, disable access to critical networks, and minimize downtime.
To learn more about use cases and examples of use, see Understanding the Ransomware Kill Switch.
To configure the Ransomware Kill Switch for a site:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Branch > Security > Ransomware Kill Switch.
On the Ransomware Kill Switch page, select the site for which you want to change threat levels from the drop-down menu.
Click the dial to change the threat level color code and apply the corresponding policies to the selected site.
Confirm the change by entering the name of the new threat level (e.g., yellow) in the pop-up window. Click Confirm to change the threat level immediately.

blocks.text: Click Notification Settings to optionally customize an email notification template that will be sent when the threat level is changed. Add one or more email addresses to receive the notification and edit the email text as needed.
